name: Alpinolino
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpinolino alpine discovery park on the Talkaser in Westendorf delights families with interactive adventure stations at 1,770 m altitude.
beschreibung:
Overview

Alpinolino Westendorf is a diverse alpine discovery and adventure park located in the heart of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Perched on the Talkaser ridge above Westendorf at an altitude of 1,770 metres, this destination transforms the mountains into an expansive open-air classroom for children and nature lovers. Under the theme "Smart alecks wanted!", visitors playfully discover the fascinating flora and fauna of the high mountains, test their senses against those of forest animals, and solve intriguing nature puzzles against a magnificent mountain backdrop.

Themed Trails & Attractions

The adventure park features several lovingly designed circular trails and interactive discovery stations for the whole family. The centrepiece is the Holzwurmweg (approx. 1.5 km, gentle downhill grade), which reveals the secrets of the mountain forest with engaging skill stations, such as a long-jump comparison with woodland creatures and a striking forest acoustics station. Another highlight is the more demanding Himmelssteig trail, leading from the Talkaser up to the summit of the Guggenbichl, revealing breathtaking panoramic views over the Brixental, the Spertental, and the Wilder Kaiser. On the "Marmot Rally", budding young explorers track down hidden marmot burrows, while sensory stations for scent and sound sharpen alpine awareness. A firm favourite is the Flugmeile, where children can glide through the air on a zip wire like a bird of prey. The experience is topped off by the Spoggolino, an enormous wooden marble run near the Choralpe, where wooden balls roll along intricate carved tracks, through labyrinths, and past melodic chimes.

Visiting & Getting There

Alpinolino is open daily from 08:30 to 17:00 during the summer operating season of the Alpenrosenbahn Westendorf cable car, from late May to late October. Admission to the entire Alpinolino park is free of charge – visitors only pay for the cable car ascent and descent. Cable car ticket prices for the Alpenrosenbahn (2025/2026 season): round trip for adults approx. €36.50, youth approx. €27.50, children approx. €18.50; substantial discounts are available with a regional guest card or the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card. By car: via the Inntal motorway A12, take exit Wörgl Ost, then follow the B178 and B170 to Westendorf and the valley station of the Alpenrosenbahn (large free car park directly at the lift station). By public transport: travel with ÖBB to Westendorf train station, from where the regional hiker bus travels directly to the valley station of the Alpenrosenbahn (or alternatively approx. a 15-minute walk through the village).

Tips

The Alpenrosenbahn cable car easily accommodates pushchairs and wheelchairs up to the Talkaser top station. The Holzwurmweg trail is suitable for all-terrain sports strollers; for the rockier Himmelssteig trail, sturdy hiking boots and surefootedness are recommended. Wooden balls for the marble run can be purchased from vending machines at the mountain station for €2.00 and taken home as souvenirs. The Talkaser mountain restaurant right beside the top station and the Choralpe mountain inn both feature sunny panoramic terraces serving hearty, authentic Tyrolean home cooking for the entire family.
